question: compare 2021 with 2023 for Gaya and Nalanda, percentage-point change in ANC4 completed divided by registered
gold_sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT district, year, 100.0 * anc4_completed / pregnancies_registered AS rate FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023)) SELECT district, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN rate END), 1) AS change_pp FROM rates GROUP BY district ORDER BY district
sql_duckdb: WITH rates AS (SELECT district, year, 100.0 * NULLIF(anc4_completed, 0) / NULLIF(NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0), 0) AS anc4_rate FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023) AND source = 'synthetic Bihar ANC fixture') SELECT r1.district, r1.year AS year_2021, r1.anc4_rate AS rate_2021, r2.year AS year_2023, r2.anc4_rate AS rate_2023, r2.anc4_rate - r1.anc4_rate AS percentage_point_change FROM rates AS r1 JOIN rates AS r2 ON r1.district = r2.district AND r1.year = 2021 AND r2.year = 2023

WITH rates AS (
  SELECT
    district,
    year,
    100.0 * NULLIF(anc4_completed, 0) / NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0) AS anc4_rate
  FROM anc_visits
  WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')
    AND year IN (2021, 2023)
    AND source = 'synthetic Bihar ANC fixture'
)
SELECT
  r1.district,
  r1.year AS year_2021,
  r1.anc4_rate AS rate_2021,
  r2.year AS year_2023,
  r2.anc4_rate AS rate_2023,
  r2.anc4_rate - r1.anc4_rate AS percentage_point_change
FROM rates r1
JOIN rates r2
  ON r1.district = r2.district
  AND r1.year = 2021
  AND r2.year = 2023;
